update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.30 - Cold start phase fix
Fixes --- - Cold start no longer jumps to scenario taps immediately after tapping a trainee — Confirm/Next must advance the phase first - Scenario picking is phase-gated only (OCR can no longer skip character confirmation) - Character pick runs before scenario pick in the navigation loop - Team home detection includes Edit Team; Career hub tap anchors off the bottom nav on tall displays - Idle cold-start logging reports phase and screen hints in logcat ([PF_COLD_START])
Includes v5.9.29 cold start phases and prior parent-farming fixes.
